newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND AND MEXICO CONFIRM WEMBLEY FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND AND MEXICO CONFIRM WEMBLEY FRIENDLY.

text.p: England and Mexico will meet in a friendly in March next year, their first match at Wembley Stadium since the 1966 World Cup finals.

The match, on March 29, is likely to be England's only game in a three-month period from when they play Italy in a World Cup qualifier in February to when they meet Poland in their next qualifier in May.

England beat Mexico 8-0 in a friendly in Wembley in 1961 and beat them 2-0 in the 1966 World Cup. The countries have met six times, with England winning three times, Mexico twice with one match drawn. Their last clash was in 1986 when England won a friendly 3-0 in Los Angeles.
Mexico's Yugoslav coach Bora Milutinovic has come under pressure recently, but his side are expected to come through the CONCACAF qualifying group to reach their 11th World Cup finals.
